svg.title: NCP 2 and iceoryx2 between two Rust processes
svg.desc: Two panels, without and with a SHA-256 check at both ends: the time of one call with 0, 127, 1788, and 87381 spikes back, on a log scale, for iceoryx2 over shared memory, NCP 2 over a pipe, a Unix socket, and TCP, and a raw pipe. Values are in summary.md.
